# budgets/grid/

The budget planning grid's pure model (Budgets P2, spec `docs/plans/budgets/P2-budget-grid-spec.md` §4.1, §5). No React, no DOM, no `@/lib/neon`: the server (wizard seed, Excel import) and the client (workspace UI) run the same functions.

## Modules
- `cents.ts`: `toCents` (reuses `core/budgetMonths.round2`), `fromCents`, `roundToUnit(cents, 1|100|1000)`, `divRoundHalfAway`, `isCents` / `MAX_CENTS` (NUMERIC(15,2) bound). Integer cents everywhere; half away from zero on the decimal value.
- `variance.ts`: `rowVariance` (Δ vs PY in cents and %, polarity by band; PY 0 → no %). Components only print it.
- `spread.ts`: `spreadEven`, `spreadSeasonal`, `spreadStep`, `uplift` → `{ok, months} | {ok:false, reason}`. All exact (BigInt); `ok:true` months are always within `MAX_CENTS`. `splitByWeights(total, count|weights, unit)` → `{ok, parts}`: the same rule over N parts with no 15 cap (a header's sub-accounts). `residueFlipsSign` flags a residue month on the other side of zero (the grid warns).
- `cellKey.ts`: `cellKey` / `parseKey` (`acct|cc1|cc2|bu|YYYY-MM`), `rowKeyOf`, `grainOf`.
- `selection.ts`: positions, ranges, `nextFocusable` (vertical moves skip non-line rows), `edgeFocusable`, `cellsIn`, `clampToEditable`.
- `keyboard.ts`: `gridReducer(state, action, ctx) → {state, effects, handled}` (the §5.2 key table).
- `pasteParse.ts`: `parseClipboard` (TSV shape only, ≤ `MAX_PASTE_CHARS`) + `parseCell` (calls the kit's `parseSaAmount`). An unclosed quote is literal; a cell holding a line break is refused.
- `tsv.ts`: `toTsv` (copy format), `centsToPlain`.
- `fill.ts`: `pasteInto`, `fillDown`, `fillRight` → `{writes, skipped, invalid}`; `copyMatrix` (the copy side: line rows × months).
- `undo.ts`: `UndoStack` (entries of `{key, before, after}`, limit 100).
- `subtotals.ts`: `BAND_ORDER`, `bandOf`, `bandSums` / `deriveTotals` / `foldBands` (GP/OP/NP per month + FY).
- `pivot.ts`: `accountGrains`, `resolveView`, `viewCellKey`, `memberTotals` (§11).
- `diff.ts`: `diffCells(base, incoming)` (import), `gridOf` (template grid), `rebaseDirty` (409 re-apply; flags value and grain conflicts). Throws on a value that is not whole cents: callers validate input first.

## Business rules
- Decision 5: spreads round every month but the LAST to the unit; the last takes the residue, so Σ months = target to the cent (a total under ~half a unit per month lands whole on the last month). Spreads keep the total they are given; `uplift`'s target is roundToUnit(ΣPY × (1+pct/100)), computed exactly (BigInt, pct to 4 dp), never as a float product.
- Do not add a money parser. Typed and pasted text goes through `parseSaAmount` (refuses "1,234" with a reason; a refused cell is reported, never written). The only local rule: a lone dash (`-`, `−`, `–`) is a budgeted zero, as Excel's accounting format and the grid's own display show zero.
- Blank (`null`) means not budgeted; `0` is a budgeted zero. Never conflate them (copy, paste, fill, import diff).
- Paste, fill, clear and copy target line rows and month columns only. The FY total column is derived; typing in it is a `commit` with `isTotal`, which the store spreads evenly.
- Decision 4: an account is edited only at its grain (from its non-null cells). Other views are read-only with a reason; the Company view of a dimension-grain account is the roll-up (Σ dims, invariant 2).
- Subtotal definitions are `aggregateFigures`' (other income is below GP, above OP); `subtotals.test.ts` holds the parity.
- Copy/cut/paste keys return `handled: false` so the native clipboard event fires; the clipboard hook does the work there (no permission API).

## Tests
`tests/unit/services/budgets/grid/*.test.ts`, one per module, each red under the mutation named in spec §14 (the run is recorded in the PR body).
